_about: Fact table for handbook batch A (iso/hb-iso-A.js). For each policy: the words or number shown on a sign, caption, chip, note or big card (use), the sentence of that policy's own text it comes from (from), and whether it is the same words (exact) or a plain-language restatement (paraphrase). tools/check-iso-facts-A.mjs fails when a from is not in the policy text, when an exact use is not inside its from, when a number or form name shown is not in the text, or when a big card has no claim.
